279208651.description:
Unbranded
Dyed Agate Geode Bookends
Mid-Century Modern Style, late 20th Century
This pair of bookends is crafted from natural agate geodes that have been professionally cut, polished, and dyed a vibrant forest green. The faces showcase the characteristic concentric banding of the agate, leading to crystallized quartz centers with small druzy vugs. The exterior retains the natural, rugged texture of the volcanic host rock, providing a striking contrast to the high-sheen polished display surfaces.
Genuine agate geode construction with polished front and inner faces
Enhanced green coloration highlights the natural silica banding and crystalline structures
Natural stone exterior with authentic rough texture and earth-toned matrix
Generic information sticker on underside identifies the material as crystallized silica formed in volcanic rock
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The polished faces are smooth with a high-gloss finish and no visible scratches or chips. The natural stone exteriors are intact with no structural cracks. The bottom surfaces are flat and stable; one piece retains a vintage gold foil informational label.
